name: ender3v2-klipper-on-mac
description: Move a Creality Ender 3 V2 from Marlin to Klipper with the Klipper host in a UTM VM on an Apple Silicon Mac (no Raspberry Pi), then calibrate it.

plugins.name: ender3v2-klipper-on-mac
plugins.description: Skill, scripts and configs to run Klipper for an Ender 3 V2 in a headless Debian VM on a Mac, with the printer's USB serial bridged over TCP, plus a full calibration method.
